description: The file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that manages the editing of multiple choice questions (MCQ). It handles UI interactions such as course selection based on semester/year, navigation between pages, and session management.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Partial class representing the server-side code for the EditMCQ.aspx web page, managing UI logic for course selection, navigation, and session management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event. Currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on selected semester/year.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course in session variable.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the login page, effectively logging out.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on newly selected semester/year.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Event handler for course selection change (currently empty).
